title: Microsoft Teams: Admin center - Intelligent insights for meeting quality
description: Gain proactive visibility into meeting quality across your organization with AI-powered insights in the Teams admin center that identify emerging patterns, highlight impacted users and locations, and surface likely causes with recommended actions. This helps IT administrators detect and address issues earlier, improve meeting quality, and stay ahead of potential disruptions.
